name: Zhejiang RIFA Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang RIFA Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells CNC machine tools in China and internationally. The company offers general tool machinery, including vertical and horizontal CNC lathes, vertical and horizontal machining centers, longmen machining centers, CNC horizontal boring machines, and automated production lines; and CNC grinders, such as bearing grinding and super automatic lines, bearing assembly automatic lines, roller grinding super automatic lines, single-machine CNC grinders, and CNC general grinding machines. It also provides aviation equipment comprising software control systems, digital assembly systems, intelligent processing …
